figurative_meaning_en: A tiger from the Sundarbans, referring to someone wild and untamable
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা জঙলা, কোনো নিয়ম মানে না।
এই জঙলা ছেলেটা কখনো শান্ত হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a jungla, he follows no rules.
This jungla boy never settles down.
history: Refers to the legendary wild tigers of the Sundarbans mangrove forests, symbolizing untamed wilderness in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural imagery of Sundarbans tigers, known for their fierce and independent nature.
